title: core.text.properties — document metadata
description: The document's properties: title, author, dates, and custom name/value properties. spec/PROFILE-RICH-DOCUMENT.md section 3.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload schema: the constant 1.

core.description: The standard properties: title, subject, author and so on.

custom.description: Custom properties, in their stored order.

lastModifiedBy.description: Name of the person who last saved the document.

created.description: When the document was created, ISO 8601 (`2026-03-01T10:15:00Z`); may be empty.

modified.description: When the document was last saved, ISO 8601; may be empty.

revision.description: The application's save counter: how many times the document has been saved. Informational; it is not a werk revision number.

CustomProp.description: A custom document property: a named value. Other programs (citation managers, document management systems) keep their per-document data here.

name.description: The property's name, unique among the custom properties (compared case-insensitively).

kind.description: The value's type: `lpwstr` (text), `i4` (32-bit integer), `r8` (floating-point number), `bool` (`true` / `false`), `filetime` (ISO 8601 date and time), or another variant type name of ISO/IEC 29500-1 section 22.4; `raw` when the value is of a type this profile does not interpret (a vector, a blob): `value` is then empty and `ooxmlSource` names where the original is kept

value.description: The value, as text in the form `kind` names.

ooxmlSource.description: Only for `kind` = `raw`: a key of the `fragments` map of the `x.wordcraft.ooxml.embedded` extension node, which holds the value. `value` is then the empty string. A reader that skips extension nodes knows the property's name and that it has a value this profile does not interpret. Absent for every other kind.
